issues.title: Deleting a new channel deletes other channel too
issues.body:
I just created a new channel.

When I went to delete it, it deleted another channel too:
![recording](https://i.gyazo.com/7f2b536344553e85f470515bd7c6bbc1.gif)

comments.body: Just noticed this. It happens in Small Wargame, Local Wargame and Tall MSG only.
